summary: This directory defines the Domain-Specific Language (DSL) structures used to transform data schemas into form metadata. It acts as the bridge between raw structural definitions and the UI-specific configuration required to render forms within the application.
responsibilities: Transform structural schemas into UI-compatible configurations
Manage form field attributes and annotations
relationships: Form field metadata extends base UI annotations to provide specific configuration options for form generation.
Structural schemas are processed to generate collections of field metadata based on provided context and annotations.
designDecisions: Use of TypeScript interfaces for strongly-typed metadata definitions
Centralized export strategy for DSL utilities
Functional approach to metadata construction from schema inputs
